item.description:
### Added - **OpenCode Go: real usage bars.** Perch now shows OpenCode's own numbers for your Go plan: the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows and when each resets. Before, the bars were an estimate from this Mac's sessions, and could show a quarter of your real usage on models with lower limits. If you've signed in to OpenCode Go in OpenCode, it just works. Otherwise paste your Go API key in Settings → General → Usage. The key stays in your Keychain and is sent only to opencode.ai. Without a key, the bars stay an estimate, and Settings says why.
### Improved - **The fleet window opens faster with many sessions.** It now builds only the rows on screen.
